examples.text: Harga tiket mengalami penyesuaian bulan ini.

gloss.arz: تشونج، اسم عيلة كوري أو صيني

translation.en: Chung is a common family name in Korea.

examples.text: Sampul buku itu berwarna biru.

translation.en: Believe in your own abilities.

note.arz: yakin = «متأكد» مش «يقين» بس: saya yakin = أنا متأكد.
note.en: yakin means «sure»: saya yakin = I'm sure.

note.en: Standard spelling is ke belakang (two words); it's also a polite way to say you're going to the toilet.

examples.text: Ketik nama kamu di kolom ini.

translation.en: Type REG space name, then send.

note.en: Always after a noun: teman baikku = my good friend.
